name: agent-coordinator
description: Presence, status, and messaging for concurrent coding agents sharing a workspace.
long_description: A lightweight presence and messaging mesh for concurrent coding agents working in the same repository: a live status board of who is doing what, direct messages, broadcasts, and wake-on-mail. Zero infrastructure - a single binary; the daemon starts itself on demand and exits when idle.

tools.name: status_board
tools.description: Every agent in the workspace with name, presence, current task, touched files, and last activity.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: Who is active or idle right now (presence only).

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Direct message to one agent by name.

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Read and clear your own unread messages.

tools.name: broadcast
tools.description: Workspace-wide need-to-know message to every active agent.
